subject: SentriQ pilot: combined credit + discount concession request
messages:
From: Alex Cho <alex.cho@sentriq.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick ask — pilot extension + credits to cover spike

Hey Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week — prod team loved the latency profile. We kicked off the 30-day pilot on May 3rd but need more runway: two key integrations are delayed and we expect a usage surge during final validation.

Can Redwood do a 30-day extension and throw in $50k in free credits to cover the validation phase? We can commit to a six-month paid contract at the end of the extension if performance holds. This is time-sensitive; our procurement deadline for vendor selection is June 15.

Attached is the current SOW and a short forecast. Happy to hop on a call.

— Alex
Sr. Product Ops, SentriQ Labs
SentriQ_Pilot_SOW_v2.pdf (pdf), usage-forecast.xlsx (xls)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Cho <alex.cho@sentriq.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-20T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — pilot extension + credits to cover spike

Hi Alex — appreciate the context and the prompt.

Quick reply: we can potentially support a 30-day extension, but the $50k free credit ask and the request to lock in a six-month post-pilot commit are both exceptions to our standard pilot policy.

I'm looping in Ben (CS) and preparing a short internal request for a combined concession (credits + a 20% one-time discount on initial bill) to present to leadership. If you can confirm the expected peak QPS and a rough token estimate for the extended period, that will help me justify the ask.

I also noted their procurement timeline — we will move fast.

Best,
Jonas
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-21T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: SentriQ pilot: concession ask — need exec ok

Marissa / Mina — forwarding SentriQ's ask. Key points:
- Customer requests: 30-day pilot extension + $50k free credits.
- Proposal we think is reasonable for preservation of deal: $50k credits + 20% one-time discount on first 3 months (not recurring).
- Customer will likely convert to a 6-month committed contract if perf is good; procurement decision target: 2027-06-15.
- Attachments: customer SOW + forecast.

Why this matters: SentriQ is a target logo in finance vertical; if we lose them now we probably won't re-engage this quarter. Expected ARR if they convert: $420k.

Asks:
1) Marissa — do you have bandwidth for a quick sign-off for the combined concession? This is slightly outside the VP discretionary credit threshold.
2) Mina — please flag any obvious finance/ASC issues (rev recognition or credit structuring) — can we tie credits to usage with clawback if they don't commit?

I can reduce the credits to $35k if that helps, but the team requests $50k to cover the validation run.

Thanks,
Jonas
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-24T10:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SentriQ pilot: concession ask — need exec ok

Jonas / Marissa — quick finance take:
- $50k credit is material but acceptable if we structure as: 1) $50k promotional credits applied to usage during extension, 2) credits expire at end of extension, 3) if customer signs committed contract within 45 days of extension end (as in their ask), then credits are treated as onboarding incentive and recognized appropriately.
- Recommend adding a simple clawback: if no commitment by 2027-07-30, remaining credit balance converts to a one-time non-deductible marketing charge (so we can recoup).
- Discount (20% x 3 months) is okay if capped at $40k net and tied to minimum spend in first paid month.

From an ASC perspective we should avoid any construct that delays revenue recognition for signed contracted revenue; credits applied during a non-contracted pilot are straightforward marketing/promotional spend.

I'll draft a 2-sentence approval clause for Marissa to sign off if you want.

Mina
Director, Finance Operations
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-29T18:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SentriQ pilot: concession ask — need exec ok

Thanks team — I reviewed. Approved on the conditions Mina outlined. Final authorization:
1) Approve $50,000 promotional credits for the 30-day extension; credits expire at extension end.
2) Approve one-time 20% discount applied to the first paid invoice (capped at $40k), conditional on a signed 6-month committed contract and minimum first-month spend of $20k.
3) Clawback: if no signed commitment by 2027-07-30, any unused credit balance is recorded as marketing expense and customer billed for remainder as a one-time charge.

Jonas — you have exec sign-off. Please update the SOW with the language and send a short T&Cs addendum to SentriQ. Ben — please coordinate CS for onboarding and ensure we capture usage telemetry. Mina — I will sign the short approval clause you mentioned; please send it.

Marissa
VP, Revenue — Redwood Inference
